## Inspecting the target graph

Target names and graph size depend on your local GEM well, dataset, aggregation, and module config files. After editing those files, start R from the repository root with `pixi shell` followed by `R`, then inspect your own graph:

```{.r filename="R"}
targets::tar_manifest(callr_function = NULL)
```

For an interactive graph in an R session:

```{.r filename="R"}
targets::tar_visnetwork(targets_only = TRUE)
```
